svg.font-family: Hanken Grotesk, Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A table of thirteen rows: what the suite declares, how many of it there are, and where each number is read from. There are five quality tiers and seven knobs resolve per tier. Each tier generates eleven installed files. The compile matrix is nine stages by five tiers, so forty-five compilations, and eight negative fixtures have to fail alongside them. A stage must make seventeen contract declarations before it compiles at all. The capability ladder has four rungs. The native parameter schema carries sixteen rows, the runtime publishes three hidden float4 keys, and the publication machine has eleven phases. Packaging refuses the payload on any of fifty-two rules. Forty CTest targets are declared across three CMake files. No live ENBSeries 0.504 acceptance is recorded anywhere in the tree, so nothing here is evidence about how the suite looks in the game.

g.text: quality tiers

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: five of them
config/quality-tiers.csv holds five canonical rows, and
ElderQuality.fxh guards the tier with an #error outside zero
through four. Tier one, balanced, is the default.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: tier knobs

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: seven per tier
Ambient occlusion directions and steps, reflection steps, depth
of field rings, bloom radius, lens ghosts, room light refinement.
Declared once as manifest columns and once as shader arms.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: generated per tier

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: eleven files
One quality ini, one tier include, and nine per-stage ini files.
GenerateElderQualityPresets.cmake has exactly three write
calls, the last inside a nine-stage loop.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: compile matrix

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 45 compilations
Nine ENB stage effects by five tiers in
CheckElderStageMatrix.cmake, each built through the exact
compiler the test locates rather than whatever is on the path.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: refusal fixtures

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: eight must fail
Seven edited stage sources plus a synthesized vertex stage. If
any one of them compiles, the matrix fails, so a compiler that
quietly stopped reading cannot pass as a clean run.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: stage declarations

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: seventeen required
ElderHostCapabilities.fxh refuses to be included until a stage
declares its capability level, each surface it owns, its scratch
owner and read, and four release exclusions.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: capability rungs

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: four of them
Identity, spatial, bridge, native. ElderResolveCapability
descends from native and returns the authored identity pixel
when no rung reports confidence.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: native parameters

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: sixteen rows
native/schema/elder-native-parameters.csv, eighteen columns
wide, under a versioned schema identifier. The typed ABI is
generated from this file rather than hand written.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: runtime payloads

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: three float4 keys
Room light, exposure colour and a status word, all hidden from
the ENB editor. The status word is written last and cleared first,
so a torn write reads as inactive.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: payload phases

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: eleven of them
RenderPayloadPhase in the runtime controller: three captures,
one invalidation, three writes, one validation and three restores.
Seven result codes report what happened.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: package refusal rules

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 52 of them
Twenty-one forbidden path components, nine name markers,
thirteen binary suffixes, four ENB binary names and five secret
patterns. A match stops the run instead of dropping the file.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: ctest targets

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 40 declared
Across the root, native and runtime CMake files. Two of them
check this card and this artwork, and they run under plain
Python without the compiler or a graphics device.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: live acceptance recorded

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: none in the tree
docs/release-validation.md states that live results remain
pending, and the release media carries a notice that it is not an
in-game capture. Upload stays blocked until that changes.

svg.text: Every count here was read from the shader, manifest, CMake script or packaging source that declares it rather than typed in, and
tools/check_repo_facts.py reads those same files. The marked row is the honest null: this repository proves that the suite compiles, generates and
packages deterministically, and it proves nothing about how a frame looks on screen.
